Luis Hernandez.description: conversing about Luis Hernandez and Tom Whitaker discussing their plans to address transparency concerns and propose local union hires and fair wages for the datacenter proposal, with plans to draft a statement together and involve Denise Brooks. @ <persona> Tom Whitaker
chat: Luis Hernandez

Hey Tom, I heard you and Marcus are gathering community feedback on the datacenter proposal. I'm curious about how you're planning to address the concerns about transparency at the upcoming town hall. Also, have you thought about how we can ensure local union hires and fair wages?
Tom Whitaker

Hey Luis, yes, Marcus and I are really focused on gathering as much community feedback as possible to highlight the concerns at the town hall. We're definitely pushing for more transparency, and I think your point about local union hires and fair wages is crucial. Maybe we can bring that up as well. I'd love to hear more about your thoughts on that.
Luis Hernandez

Thanks, Tom. I believe having a firm commitment on local union hires and ensuring prevailing wages will be key to getting the support of the workers. Maybe we can draft a proposal or a statement together to present at the town hall? I think having something concrete will make a strong case.
Tom Whitaker

That sounds like a great idea, Luis. Let's work on drafting that proposal together. We can outline the need for local union hires and fair wages, and I'll bring it up with Marcus too. How about we meet later this week to start putting it together?
Luis Hernandez

Sounds good, Tom. How about we meet on Thursday evening after work at the pub? We can go over our ideas and start drafting the proposal. Let's also see if we can get some input from Denise Brooks since she's been supportive of the local-hire agreement as well.
